Protocol boundaryACE, AP2, UCP, ACP

Outcome Assurance consumes protocol facts. It does not replace authorization, identity, mandates, credentials, checkout transport, or merchant order systems.

RailProvidesOutcome Assurance adds
Amex ACEAgent registration, account enablement, credentials, cart contextMembership-aware intent and outcome proof
AP2Mandates, receipts, authorized constraintsTask definition before payment and reconciliation after it
UCPDiscovery, checkout, orders, fulfillment, post-purchasePortable success criteria across merchants
ACPAgent-to-seller checkout and order eventsApproved meaning, value delta, verifier, recovery
OutcomeBench 2.0Frozen synthetic evaluation

24 frozen synthetic cases

16 development cases, 8 holdout cases, adversarial failures, a prompt-only baseline, and Wilson 95% intervals. Both evaluators use the same harness.
